name: Death to the Dragonmaw
summary: At Dragonmaw Retreat, Howin Kindfeather asks you to thin the Dragonmaw ranks. He hopes to reach Grim Batol and reclaim it for the Wildhammers, or learn more about it.

sections.title: Dragonmaw Retreat
sections.body: Dragonmaw orcs have gathered along the retreat, where red dragons routed them before. Howin needs their numbers reduced before he can approach Grim Batol. He points you east along the road to find them.

faq.answer: Howin Kindfeather hopes to get back into Grim Batol and reclaim it for the Wildhammers, or at least learn more about it.
Howin says Dragonmaw orcs are marching through Dragonmaw Retreat. He needs their numbers thinned before he can approach Grim Batol.
The Dragonmaw orcs are along Dragonmaw Retreat. Howin points you east along the road to find them.
Howin names Dragonmaw Reclaimers, Dragonmaw Soulbinders, and Dragonmaw Infiltrators.
Red dragons routed the Dragonmaw orcs at Dragonmaw Retreat before.

attribution: In-game quest text: Death to the Dragonmaw
